requirements.text: Full Stack Engineer - LA or SF
They must have shipped AI features to production and be comfortable owning architecture and core product reliability from day one.
They must have shipped AI features to production and be comfortable owning architecture and core product reliability from day one.
They need to be a strong full stack engineer who can turn messy real world workflows into reliable software systems.
They will design and evolve a serverless, event driven architecture that processes recruiting activity data in real time.
They need experience building multi step AI systems using orchestration frameworks such as Mastra or similar agent frameworks.
They must understand how to route tasks across different model tiers, using large models for generation and smaller models for classification and structured reasoning.
They should be comfortable building event ingestion pipelines that process webhooks, transcripts, and CRM activity into structured signals.
They need experience working with retrieval systems that combine proprietary knowledge bases with context aware AI generation.
They must design systems with strong failure isolation, retry handling, and durable queues so individual failures never break the pipeline.
